service.description: ChannelRouting's IntakeRoutes: one of the user's settings organizations' queues with their routes in effect (mail, public form, forum, chat; each with its type, sender and automatic-mail rules, acknowledgement and last error), the Comms mail rules whose createRequest action names one of the queues, each queue's public form token state, the requests held for review, and the options of RouteEdit and RouteTest. For the administrator and the service manager (PERMISSION_DENIED); another organization is refused (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

ChannelSessions' SessionFind and SessionList: the calls, chats and mail of a customer the user serves and its contacts (Mantle's find#PartyCommunicationEvents with the customer audience: no note, internal message or internal call), or with no customer those filed on the cases the user sees; by channel (phone, chat, email), agent, period and linked or not, newest first, at most 100, each with its case when the user sees it. Refuses a customer the user does not serve (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: linked
parameter.description: Y, N or empty for both

service.description: The call-context provider of the Customer Service root (Comms' ring bar and call; design §1 Stack contributions): the caller's open cases the user sees (customer or reporter by the caller's number), each with its CaseDetail link; the contacts are Comms' own provider's. Nothing for a user without Customer Service.

Create case from a message (the Comms hooks: a mail's MessageDetail, Chat's message actions and Voicemail's actions): a case for the customer the sender is or is a contact of (CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE for staff or anyone the user does not serve), in the queue given (one the user works: QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE) else the type's or the policy's, through Mantle's create#Request and ensure#CaseProfile at once (the case rule: no template values, so no P7 template check): a mail (one the user may read: RECORD_UNAVAILABLE; not on a request yet: ALREADY_FILED) filed on it with its received date its intake time; a chat message (one of a room the user reads) linked by its communication event; a voicemail (the user's) as an inbound call with its transcript, never its audio. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT. Out: the case, its link and a message.

The PASS forum topic a case was escalated from (its PublicDiscussionLink of source case: site, topic and title), for CaseDetail's Reply publicly in forum; topic null for a case from none. Refuses a case the user does not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).
